name: F5d_contradictory_dim_conflicting
sw_rationale: Family 5 - add a contradictory width dimension (c12=90, conflicting with c10=80) on top of the fully defined F5a. Expected: at least one of {c10, c12} in conflicting list, solver may or may not converge cleanly. SolidWorks highlights both conflicting dimensions in yellow. The geometric result is undefined (least-squares compromise). Confidence HIGH for conflicting detection.

expect._conflicting_note: c10 (width=80) and c12 (width=90) directly contradict each other. SolidWorks flags BOTH in yellow. The solver's conflicting list must be non-empty and contain at least one of {c10, c12}. Confidence HIGH.
expect._coord_notes: Width is indeterminate between 80 and 90. converged may be false or solver may settle at a compromise ~85.
